newsitem.title: USA: More Miller ad business goes to Leo Burnett.
newsitem.headline: More Miller ad business goes to Leo Burnett.

text.p: Miller Brewing Co, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, said Monday that it had consolidated almost all of its remaining media planning and buying with Leo Burnett Co Inc.

The company said that it would assign Burnett all primetime and cable assignments. The agency already handles media planning and buying for sports programming for Miller's entire portfolio of brands, said the company.
The new business was previously handled by Televest, the media buying unit of D'arcy Masius Benton & Bowles.
Miller would not disclose the size of the account, but total billings with Burnett have been reported in excess of $300 million.
The company said the consolidation will not affect the agency which plans and buys Miller's Hispanic media.
Burnett has suffered the loss of several major accounts this year, including UAL Corp's United Airlines.
